mapper.select: SELECT contract_id,COALESCE(ad_id,0) AS ad_id,COALESCE(advertiser_id,0) AS advertiser_id,COALESCE(guaranteed,0) AS guaranteed, COALESCE((extract(epoch from start_ts)*1000)::bigint,0) AS s, COALESCE((extract(epoch from end_ts)*1000)::bigint,0) AS e, COALESCE((price_cpm*1000)::bigint,0) AS cpm_milli FROM ad_contract WHERE status='active'
